item.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption sought submissions on lobbying regulation to determine whether further work was needed.
item.support: The Commission is calling for submissions relating to lobbying regulation in South Australia

item.text: The discussion paper asked about the definition of lobbying, obligations on officials being lobbied, former officials’ employment, local government and consistency between jurisdictions.
item.support: Should the conduct of lobbied parties be more closely regulated?

item.text: The Commission explained that lobbying could inform policy, while opaque or exclusive access could increase the risk of improper influence.
item.support: The lobbying of Government officials can play a positive role in informing Government policies and priorities

item.text: It invited responses to its questions and other lobbying issues to guide its consideration of reform.
item.support: Your submission may address the issues and questions detailed below, or any other aspect of lobbying
